8005 Opportunity Table Create Endpoint (#8498)

## Summary

Fixes for #8005 

## Changes proposed

Adding Create Endpoint for Creating new opportunities.

## Context for reviewers

[Tech
Spec](https://navasage.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Grantsgov/pages/2612789251/Phase+1+Core+Foundations)

Opportunity Publishing in Simpler Grants will enable the creation of
funding opportunities directly into Simpler Grants. With this
capability, key opportunity data can be entered into Simpler Grants and
displayed to applicants in a consistent, unified experience. This PR is
focused on making the Create endpoint for creating a new opportunity.

Endpoint information:

`POST /v1/grantors/opportunities/`

Expected responses:

- 200 - Successful response (opportunity is created)
- 401 - Authentication error
- 403 - User does not have the `create_opportunity` for their assigned
agency
- 404 - Agency ID doesn't exist
- 422 - User attempts to create opportunity with number that already
exists/Missing Data

## Validation steps

- [x] 5 new Unit Tests pass
- [x] Confirmed all expected request+responses on local
- [x] Confirmed all information populates in local DB
